incident-bot: [ALERT] embeddings-hotspot us-west-2 — p99 latency >1500ms, sustained QPS spike ~18k. Paging oncall @anna

anna (oncall): taking the pager, looking at dashboards now

anna (oncall): quick snapshot — embeddings route CPU 92%, KV evictions climbing, request queue length rising despite autoscale

maria (eng-runtime): confirmed on traces. heavy fanout on embed.encode, tails look like GC/backpressure from the runtime on some nodes

kevin (prod): any immediate customer-facing impact? which tiers affected?

anna (oncall): mid/low tiers will likely see 429s if we leave this. plan: apply temporary per-endpoint QPS cap on embeddings and shift some capacity to chat. Also disable non-SLA rerank to shave CPU.

anna (oncall): running mitigation command now: `rdwctl routes update --route embeddings-prod --qps-cap 4000 --note "auto-mitigate: reduce hot-route pressure"`

deploy-bot: job 8842 started — rdwctl routes update embeddings-prod (initiated by anna)

maria (eng-runtime): rolling out feature toggle: disable rerank on non-sla routes. command: `rdwctl feature-toggle disable --feature rerank --scope non-sla`

deploy-bot: job 8843 started — disable rerank (scope: non-sla) by anna

kevin (prod): ok. Heads-up: this will affect some customers that rely on rerank for precision; we'll surface a one-line note to support and affected customers.

raj (sre): i can take monitoring for the next hour. If latency doesn't improve, i'll consider a softer cap (6k) and enable local cache warming.

anna (oncall): handing off to @raj — summary for handoff: embeddings qps cap set to 4k, non-SLA rerank disabled, watch p99 and eviction rate. Customer impact: mid/low-tier embeddings may receive 429; high-tier preserved by SLA routing. Support notified in #support.

raj (sre): noted. escalation plan: if p99 > 800ms after 10m, revert qps cap to 6k and re-enable rerank for low-risk routes, or run cache warm: `scripts/warm_kv_cache.sh embeddings 10000`

maria (eng-runtime): metrics just updated — embeddings QPS ~3.9k, p50 60ms, p95 320ms, p99 480ms. Props to the traffic-sculpt action.

anna (oncall): excellent. i'll write a short incident note and close the pager; @raj please keep eyes for 30m and escalate if regressions. :thumbsup:

raj (sre): will do, watching dashboards. closing pager from my side if stable for 30m. ping me directly for any weird 5xx patterns.
